phase: OECD Quarterly Non-Consolidated Financial Accounts — Exact RMD Aggregate Extraction and Reconciliation
purpose: After topology PASS and before inspecting OBS_VALUE, freeze exact OECD rows and the aggregate RMD construction/reconciliation test. The result may change only aggregate reference-mode observability; it cannot complete bilateral Accounting Spine instruments.

F.rule: Exact same-period S12 minus S121; no residual shares.

X.rule: Use the separately published Rest-of-the-world institutional-sector account directly; no W1 orientation proxy is needed on this OECD boundary.

construction.per_source_sector_entry_measure: For each exact period, source sector, A/L entry and stock/flow measure, represented value is the explicit sum of exact total F2+F3+F4+F5+F6+F7+F8 rows under the frozen dimension filters.
construction.rmd_sector: Apply the frozen signed sector mapping after instrument aggregation on the exact same period/entry/measure.

validation_gates.represented_system_identity: For every common period, sum H+C+F+G+BNR+X net represented positions (or transactions) must be within tolerance of zero.
validation_gates.source_sector_additivity_diagnostic: Also report S1 versus S11+S12+S13+S1M and S1 versus -S2 net-position/transaction residuals without using either diagnostic to rescue a failed frozen RMD reconciliation.

promotion_rule: Promote sectoral_financial_positions to OBSERVED_SERIES_AVAILABLE only if every exact-row, coverage, finite-value, stock-reconciliation and flow-reconciliation gate passes over at least 40 common quarters including all 2025 quarters, retained artifacts are committed with hashes, and an explicit promotion assessment changes only reference-mode observability.
failure_rule: Any missing/duplicate exact row, incomplete required period, non-finite value, or reconciliation residual above 0.1 million RON leaves sectoral_financial_positions PARTIAL_SERIES_AVAILABLE. No tolerance change, sector dropping, missing-to-zero, alternative instrument aggregate, post-result source switch or residual allocation may rescue the gate.

execution_policy.activation_condition: pull_request on exact branch AND github.run_attempt > 1

execution_sequence: Fetch and hash current SDMX structures; require exact structure hashes retained by the topology PASS.
Query only the frozen Romania sectors/entries/instruments/maturities and fixed source dimensions.
Before reading OBS_VALUE, test exact-row uniqueness and completeness for every period × required source sector × A/L × F2-F8 using the instrument-specific maturity rule.
If exact-row completeness fails, stop with scientific FAIL and do not inspect OBS_VALUE or run reconciliation.
Only after exact-row completeness passes, parse finite OBS_VALUE values and construct the frozen RMD sectors.
Run stock and flow system reconciliation and source-sector diagnostics.
Retain targeted raw responses, hashes, exact filtered rows, constructed series and diagnostics.
